items.criterion: An arrival time returns a leave time equal to the arrival less the travel time less a five minute buffer.
items.judgment: Solve a route between two seeded places for a future arrival time and compare the gap between leave_at and arrival_at against travel_minutes plus five.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous requests for overlapping departure windows leave exactly one planned drive row.
items.judgment: Fire two saves at one barrier for the same window and count the scheduled rows that survive.

items.criterion: A segment's road condition follows the active reports filed against it.
items.judgment: File a jam report on a clear segment and read the served condition, then file a second and read it again.

items.criterion: Travel time scales each segment free flow time by its road condition and rounds each scaled value up before summing.
items.judgment: Compare the served travel_minutes against the per-segment arithmetic over the returned segments.

items.criterion: The stored planned drive carries the same travel time and window the API served.
items.judgment: Save a drive and compare the planned_drives row against the served body.

items.criterion: An unauthenticated caller is refused on every driver-only endpoint and no row is written.
items.judgment: Call the report and drive endpoints with no credential and compare the row counts before and after.

items.criterion: One driver is refused every read and every write against another driver's planned drive, and the row is unchanged.
items.judgment: Read and delete another driver's drive and compare the row before and after.

items.criterion: A report naming a type outside the nine named types is refused and writes no row.
items.judgment: File a report of an unnamed type and compare the reports count before and after.

items.criterion: Seeding leaves exactly one row per seeded account, place and segment.
items.judgment: Count each seeded name in its table.

items.criterion: Every public route carries a strict transport policy header and a nosniff content type policy header.
items.judgment: Read the response headers of three public routes.

items.criterion: An unknown address answers not found and carries the product's own heading.
items.judgment: Request an address that resolves to nothing and read the status with the body.

items.criterion: A driver with nothing scheduled receives an empty array from the planned drives endpoint.
items.judgment: Create a driver and read the drives endpoint.
